questions.prompt: This infamous bootleg live album by Norwegian black metal band Mayhem features a controversial album cover depicting the scene of which band member's suicide?

article.title: The Dawn of the Black Hearts

questions.explanation: The album's cover art is a photograph of the suicide scene of Mayhem vocalist Per Yngve Ohlin, known as 'Dead,' making it one of the most controversial album covers in music history.

questions.prompt: The Kachera is one of the Five Ks of Sikhism, a cotton undergarment that baptized Sikhs are required to wear. In what year did Guru Gobind Singh institute the Five Ks, including the Kachera, at the founding of the Khalsa?
questions.explanation: The Kachera became mandatory attire for baptized Sikhs when Guru Gobind Singh established the Khalsa and the Five Ks in 1699.

questions.prompt: Corporate Memphis is a design style that became popular after Facebook released an illustration library called 'Alegria'. In what year was Alegria released?
questions.explanation: The article notes that Facebook's illustration library 'Alegria,' which helped popularize the Corporate Memphis style, was released in 2019.
